app.noCardsHint: Add your first credit card to start tracking purchases and installments month by month.

welcome.title: Welcome to ccExpedition!
welcome.body: Here is a quick tour of how to track your credit card spending month by month.

cardList.title: Your cards
cardList.body: Pick All Cards for the consolidated view, or a single card to see its expenses in detail.

consolidated.title: Maximum budget
consolidated.body: Set a monthly cap and months that exceed it are highlighted in the grid.

table.title: Installments by month
table.body: The grid shows what you owe on each card per month. Click a cell to see the breakdown.

import.title: Import Excel
import.body: Upload your monthly bank statement (.xlsx) to add expenses automatically.

addCard.title: Add card
addCard.body: Create a card with a name, holder, and color to organize your spending.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Customize colors, language, budget alerts, and edit your card names.

monthBar.title: Months
monthBar.body: Browse months to see which expenses hit in each billing period.

addExpense.title: Add expense
addExpense.body: Add installment purchases, one-time charges, or monthly subscriptions.

cardDetail.title: Card detail
cardDetail.body: Select a card above to view its expenses, edit subscriptions, or add new purchases.

empty.title: Start here
empty.body: Add your first card to start tracking expenses.

login.toggleToSignUp: Don't have an account? Sign up
login.toggleToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
login.accountCreated: Account created. Check your email if confirmation is required, then sign in.

cardDetail.noExpensesHintEmpty: Add your first purchase to see it spread across the months above.
cardDetail.noExpensesHintPick: Pick another month above or add a new expense.

payment.title: Record payment — {{card}} · {{month}}
payment.paidFullQuestion: Did you pay the full amount for this month?
payment.partialHint: Enter how much you paid. The remainder is added to next month as pending balance.
payment.pendingBalanceNote: It is added automatically as «Pending balance» and cannot be edited or deleted.

balanceAdjustment.hint: This amount is subtracted from the chosen month's total in the month bar and consolidated view.
balanceAdjustment.paymentAdvanceHint: You overpaid and the surplus lowers the summary for the month you pick.
balanceAdjustment.creditBalanceHint: The card returned balance or interest that reduces what you owe that month.
balanceAdjustment.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. July statement advance, interest refund…
balanceAdjustment.applyMonthHint: Pick the month whose total you want to reduce.

consolidated.budgetExceeded: Highlighted months exceed your {{amount}} budget alert.

addExpense.title: Add Expense — {{card}}
addExpense.monthlyChargeHint: Same amount every month (e.g. Netflix, Spotify).

import.title: Import from Excel
import.chooseFile: Choose an .xlsx file (bank statement or Card Tracker export)
import.modeStatement: Monthly statement — all rows belong to one billing month (CUOTA 7/12 = payment 7 of 12 this month).
import.modePurchases: Purchase list — FECHA is installment 1 start date.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showPreviousMonthsHint: Include months before the current month in the grid.
settings.showPaidRowHint: Shows the Paid row in the all-cards view.
settings.workspaceTitleHint: Shown below ccExpedition in the top bar. Each user has their own.
settings.deleteWarning: This will permanently remove the card and its {{count}} {{expenseLabel}}. This cannot be undone.

errors.nothingToPay: There is nothing to pay this month
errors.paidExceedsDue: Paid amount exceeds the month total
